title: resolve_target double-parses the ID string
description: src/interactions.rs:138-162. resolve_target() parses id_str as i64 on line 140, then parses it again as i64 on line 148. The second parse is dead code — it will always produce the same result as the first since the string hasn't changed. The intermediate let id: i64 from line 140 should just be reused directly.
